title: Fmpz IntegerBuffer Boundary
objective: Add fail-closed resident-fmpz IntegerBuffer root ingress and publication views with ordinary GMP only at the public root ABI, proven by compiled/dynamic/GMP/fmpz differential and structural tests

handoff.summary: Closed resident-fmpz roots may now borrow packed IntegerBuffer parameters and use length, indexed ingress, and publication without converting through mpz_t inside the native program. The boundary helpers import unsigned sign-magnitude limbs directly into fmpz values and export positive or negative fmpz values directly back to caller-owned packed storage, including promoted 4095-bit values. Selection remains deliberately fail-closed for copied/local buffers and buffer-bearing helpers. A buffer-only fmpz program also now content-addresses and links FLINT itself instead of accidentally relying on an unrelated declared FFI import. Generated-C assertions prove the internal root and helper bodies contain no GMP conversion calls; compiled fmpz, tagged, GMP, and dynamic implementations agree across small, negative, promoted, aliased, capacity-failure, and recovery cases, with an independent ASan/UBSan/LSan harness covering lifecycle and failure reuse.
risks: The certified cubic root remains on GMP. IntegerBuffer length/get/set are now qualified, but the root still uses UInt64Buffer length/set and uint64.from_integer_checked, NativeIntegerVector accesses with Integer indices, FmpzPolynomial and NumberFieldAnalysisResource arena owners, and unqualified HNF/LLL/SNF, polynomial, logarithm-ball, and number-field-analysis declarations.

Direct packed views require FLINT_BITS == 64 and fail at C compilation otherwise. This matches every currently supported native target, but only Linux x64 compilation and execution were exercised locally; Linux arm64, macOS arm64, and Windows x64 remain integration-lane validation.

architecture:check reaches the inherited stale architecture/optimizer-opportunities.manifest.json input hash (expected 9c902293, found 4f6cafa7) after all preceding FFI, package, native, Wasm, resource-lifetime, and CoWasm checks pass.

The broad test:native run was stopped during production-pack publication at integration's request so this completed intermediate compiler slice would release overlapping claims promptly. The focused compiler/differential/sanitizer suite, full native-kernel suite, strict baselib checks, and merge checks passed; integration will run the broader native matrix after composing the successor lanes.
next_steps: Qualify borrowed NativeIntegerVector parameters and Integer indexing without changing ownership or admitting buffer-bearing helpers prematurely.
Add the cubic root's UInt64Buffer boundary views and checked Integer-to-uint64 conversion while keeping selection fail-closed.
Qualify FmpzPolynomial and NumberFieldAnalysisResource ownership plus their construction, sealing, logarithm-ball, analysis, and projection declarations.

Qualify the matrix HNF, LLL, and SNF declarations used by the cubic closure, then re-audit the entire 83-function program and assert that generated internal code has zero mpz conversions before selecting the root.
